1.

The instant petition has been filed for a writ of mandamus commanding the respondents to pay compensation to the petitioner amounting to Rs. 2,55,32,000/- in accordance with the provisions of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparancy in Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 and not to force the petitioner to execute sale deed in respect of his land.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparancy
entities.label: STATUTE

entities.text: Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
2. The case of the petitioner is that the amount awarded as compensation is at agricultural rate whereas the land is non agricultural, and therefore, the petitioner has prayed for the relief noted Omendra Yadav vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others on 9 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/156427976/
1 above.
3.

entities.text: Omendra Yadav vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It is not disputed that the land of the petitioner was subject matter of acquisition under the provisions of the Act.
The notification under Section 11 was issued on 16.07.2022 and under Section 19 on 15.10.2022 and award has been declared on 06.07.2023.
4. The petitioner has filed an amendment application seeking to challenge the award.
However, the prayer is declined in as much as the remedy to challenge the award on the ground that compensation awarded is inadequate, is by way of reference under Section 64 of the Act.
5. Consequently, we dispose of the petition with liberty to the petitioner to avail the said remedy, if so advised.
